Counted from the latest display block forward, not by the number of dialogue rounds or tool calls.
• Each user message and assistant reply count as 1 block each.
• Consecutive read/search/catalog tools combined into 1 block; contiguous local commands also combined into 1 block. Other tools count as 1 piece each.
• After the group is expanded, it is still counted as 1 block, and 100 items are displayed in the group first; the large diff has other restrictions and can continue to be expanded.
For example: question + reply + 10 consecutive reads + reply, a total of 4 blocks.
defaults to 80 blocks, which is suitable for general tasks; if you want to see more history for long tasks, you can set it to 100. The higher the number, the more memory the interface usually takes up. The history exceeded by
can be viewed by turning pages. It does not delete messages, does not change the model context, and is not a precise memory limit.
